column1: # C's svt_aom_global_motion_estimation decision vs the port's port_global_me
# derivation, joined field for field by tools/gm_join_gate.sh.
# tree   : the GM-derivation commit on main (see git log for the sha)
# C side : tools/ctrace-linux/run.sh (docker/colima arm64, generic -O3 build of
#          reference/svt-av1, NATIVE=OFF, runtime RTCD), SVT_GM_OUT interposer
# port   : SVTAV1_GMDBG=1, GMPORT line, printed before the refusal.
# result : 8 cells joined, 0 mismatching fields, 2 cells where C fitted a
# C's fitted models on the two zoom cells (SVT_GM_OUT GMREF lines), recorded so
# the search port has a target to reproduce before it is wired:
# 0.9697 and 8/9 = 0.8889, so C recovered the synthetic zoom to ~1e-3.
# Cells where C RUNS the search and still returns IDENTITY (the port refuses
# these, conservatively — they are what porting compute_global_motion closes):
# The port now RUNS compute_global_motion. Joined against SVT_GMSEARCH_OUT (a
# two exported leaves of C's static per-reference driver), on
# crop:CID22/3571065 256x256 q40 p2 with a 33/32 zoom:
# and on the 512x512 9/8-zoom cell both models likewise
# C's plane geometry, from GMREFINE: r=256x256/400 d=256x256/400 — the TRUE
# picture dims and each buffer's own padded stride. The port passes tight
# planes (392 / 256) and gets the same numbers, because port_warp clamps every
# C's allow_high_precision_mv argument is 0 at ME time regardless of qp
# (GMCOST hp=0 at q10 AND q20): frm_hdr.allow_high_precision_mv is assigned in
# BYTE OUTCOME after the search wire, identity_diff_inter frames=2 q40 shift 3,
#   crop:CID22/3571065 128 and 256 at p2 and p4                        4 / 4
# Still open: photo p0 differs on FRAME 0 (a key frame, tools/photo_p0_gate.sh),
# and the 512 photo diverges at p0/p2/p4.
# The three branches of C's chain and what the port does with each:
#   search runs, RANSAC fits nothing      -> encodes (port's own search says so)
#   search runs, fits a ROTZOOM           -> REFUSES (the model is uncoded)
